**Duluth Holdings Inc. - Second Amendment to Credit Agreement**

## 1. Executive Summary

**Date of Agreement:** January 31, 2025

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Duluth Holdings Inc., a Wisconsin corporation

**Transaction Description:** Second Amendment to Credit Agreement among Duluth Holdings Inc. (Borrower), Guarantors, Lenders, and Bank of America, N.A. as Administrative Agent. This is an amendment to an existing revolving credit facility originally dated May 14, 2021.

**Purpose of Financing:** N/A (specific purpose not disclosed in the amendment)

**Company Background:** N/A (company background not provided in the amendment document)

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Established banking relationships** - Facility includes four reputable financial institutions with Bank of America serving as Administrative Agent
• **Covenant holiday provision** - Financial covenant testing suspended for the Fiscal Quarter ending February 2, 2025
• **Dividend restriction** - Prohibits cash dividends and share repurchases, preserving cash for debt service
• **Quarterly financial reporting** - Regular compliance certificate requirements provide ongoing monitoring

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Pricing penalty implementation** - Applicable Rate set at highest pricing level (Level 6) from amendment effective date until May 4, 2025 compliance certificate delivery, indicating potential financial stress
• **Restrictive leverage covenant** - Maximum Rent Adjusted Leverage Ratio of 3.50:1.00 may limit operational flexibility
• **Coverage ratio requirements** - Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of 1.20:1.00 provides limited cushion for cash flow volatility
